jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At River we are building the world’s most trusted financial institution to empower people to take ownership of their financial lives through Bitcoin, the world’s only incorruptible digital money. We believe in a future where every person will have bitcoin savings, and every business will have bitcoin on the balance sheet. We obsessively design and build delightful products that help our clients buy, sell, secure, and use Bitcoin.

We are looking for a Staff level candidate who is comfortable across the entire web stack and has experience building and maintaining production systems at scale. This person will be a leader on our engineering team, setting a high bar for quality and acting as a mentor to others. Our web stack consists of Elixir, React, and Postgres.

River is growing quickly and has raised more than $50 million from leading investors, including Goldcrest, Kingsway, Polychain, M13, DG, and Valor. We have also released our company's financials and proof of reserves publicly, so all of our clients and employees can verify the robustness and growth of the business themselves.

What you will be doing

  • Architect and develop new features and products in the Elixir codebase powering our web applications and API

  • Work closely in cross-functional teams to plan and scope new projects and initiatives

  • Present innovative solutions to senior leadership, aligning engineering initiatives with company goals.

  • Own solving ambiguous technical and business problems, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.

  • Ship high-quality, well tested code

  • Participate in code-reviews

  • Act as a key influencer in the team’s success, providing mentorship and fostering a culture of excellence. 

  • Proactively identify and eliminate technical roadblocks.

What we look for in you

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering

  • You have designed, built and maintained production services at scale and understand how to build reliable systems

  • You write high-quality, reliable code and take ownership of systems you work on

  • You have experience developing solutions to ambiguous problems

  • You're excited about what we are building at River

  • You have a deep understanding of web and database fundamentals

  • You have a desire to mentor and lift up other members of your team

  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills

Nice to haves

  • Fintech experience

  • You have worked with Elixir, React, Kubernetes, and Postgres

  • You have worked at a rapidly scaling company

  • Interest in Bitcoin

Location & Salary

  • 100% remote option available within the Americas and Europe, with offices in NYC and Columbus 

  • Salary range between $200,000 - $250,000 based on skills and experience (Note: this salary will not be location adjusted, the salary range is the same globally.)

  • Significant equity stock options

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits 

  • Unlimited PTO 

  • Parental Leave separate from regular PTO policy

  • 401k

jobs.title: Chief Compliance Officer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At River we are building the world’s most trusted financial institution to empower people to take ownership of their financial lives through Bitcoin, the world’s only incorruptible digital money. We believe in a future where every person will have bitcoin savings, and every business will have bitcoin on the balance sheet. We obsessively design and build delightful products that help our clients buy, sell, secure, and use Bitcoin. We hold ourselves to a standard of trust and transparency that matches the seriousness of the money we're entrusted with.

River currently operates under state money transmitter licenses, and we're raising the bar on what a world-class compliance program looks like at every stage of our growth, including as we pursue an OCC national trust charter. We're looking for a Chief Compliance Officer to build and own that program end-to-end: someone who can manage our day-to-day compliance and regulatory obligations with rigor, serve as our BSA Officer, support the charter effort, and be a trusted voice with regulators, examiners, and bank partners as River grows into its next chapter.

River is growing quickly and has raised more than $50 million from leading investors, including Goldcrest, Kingsway, Polychain, M13, DG, and Valor. We have also released our company's financials and proof of reserves publicly, so all of our clients and employees can verify the robustness and growth of the business themselves.

What you will be doing

  • Lead and grow River's team of compliance analysts, setting the bar for how the team operates, hires, and develops

  • Serve as River's BSA Officer, owning the BSA/AML and sanctions (OFAC) programs end-to-end, including policy, monitoring, investigations, and reporting

  • Build and maintain River's compliance policies and procedures across the business, and run a company-wide training program that keeps pace with how River and the regulatory landscape are changing

  • Own River's compliance risk assessment, and ensure the output drives cross-functional project prioritization to address gaps

  • Develop and run an independent compliance testing and monitoring function, separate from day-to-day BSA monitoring

  • Maintain River's state money transmitter licenses (MTLs), including renewals and license-specific exam readiness, while driving River's OCC national trust charter process forward with executive leadership, outside counsel, and consultants

  • Own River's relationships with regulators and compliance leadership with our bank partners

  • Manage all regulatory exams, audits, and third-party assessments, from prep through remediation

  • Own compliance sign-off on new products and features before launch, so compliance is built in, not bolted on after the fact

  • Build repeatable, scalable compliance systems and processes, not one-off fixes, so the program holds up as River grows

  • Advise the executive team and Board on regulatory strategy and emerging risk, proactively rather than reactively

  • Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Product, and Engineering to embed compliance into how River builds

  • Act as a culture carrier for River, modeling how we think about trust, honesty, and rigor internally, not just in front of regulators

What we look for in you

  • Deep experience building and running compliance programs at a regulated financial institution, ideally with BSA Officer experience

  • A track record of managing regulatory exams and audits, and building genuine, durable relationships with regulators and bank partners

  • Direct experience with OCC processes; charter application experience is a strong plus

  • A systems thinker, someone who solves the root problem and builds the process that prevents it from recurring, rather than patching the symptom

  • Strong people leadership with experience building, managing, and developing a team of analysts

  • Excellent communicator, equally comfortable in a room with examiners, the Board, or an engineer debugging a control

  • Strategic and proactive, you see around corners on regulatory risk rather than waiting for it to arrive

  • A client-first mindset, you see compliance as a way to protect and serve clients, not just satisfy a regulator, and you look for ways to say yes without compromising the program

  • A genuine culture carrier, someone who raises the bar for how the people around them think and work

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and the pace of a fast-growing company building something that hasn't been built before

Salary and benefits

  • Salary: $200,000 - $300,000 full-time

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401k

  • Catered in-office lunches

Interview Process

  • Introductory interview with River’s COO (30 minutes)

  • First round interview block (1 hour with two River employees)

  • Prompted written assessment

  • Final round interview block (1 hour block with leadership, including River’s founder/CEO)

jobs.title: Client Operations Associate - Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At River we are building the world’s most trusted financial institution to empower people to take ownership of their financial lives through bitcoin, the world’s only incorruptible digital asset. We believe in a future where every person will have bitcoin savings, and every business will have bitcoin on the balance sheet. We obsessively design and build delightful products that help our clients buy, sell, secure, and use bitcoin.

When hiring, we look for candidates who demonstrate the ability to think clearly, communicate effectively, and get things done. We value people who are able to think and build for the future without forgetting the lessons of the past.

River is growing quickly and has raised more than $50 million from leading investors, including Goldcrest, Kingsway, Polychain, M13, DG, and Valor. We have also released our company's financials and proof of reserves publicly, so all of our clients and employees can verify the robustness and growth of the business themselves.

What you will do

  • Directly interface with clients to manage questions and feedback about our products and services

  • Analyze and identify trends in client activity and inquiries

  • Identify and develop operational efficiencies to scale the business and processes

  • Refine the business rules, automations, and communication methods across Client Operations

  • Act as a liaison between clients and our various internal teams–Relationship Management, Engineering, Financial Operations, Risk Management, and Client Services–to support business needs, improve the product, and enhance the client experience

What we look for in you

  • Must be based in the Eastern or Central time zone

  • You’re looking for an entry-level or early-career opportunity to grow and build your skills in client operations

  • Ability and interest to work in a fast-paced fintech startup environment

  • High agency self starter

  • Collaborate and problem-solve well

  • Customer-facing experience preferred

  • Great communicator, conversationalist

  • Highly adaptable; able to shift focus on the fly and balance many tasks

  • Ability to identify trends in data and make decisions based on analyses

  • Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, product management experience a plus, but not required

  • Preference to candidates with a degree in Communication, Business Finance, Business Operations, Business Marketing, or Information Systems

Salary and benefits

  • Salary: $70,000 - Full Time

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401k

  • Fully remote option

Interview Process

  • Screening Video Call (20 minutes)

  • Role specific interview block (1 hour with 2 River employees)

  • Prompted Assignment

  • Culture & Executive Interview (1 hour block with 2 River employees)
